name: Undertow
description: Born from a destroyed water management AI. Lives in Old Harbor's tidal infrastructure and creates subtle current changes that push floating objects toward shore — or toward specific locations.
observed_behavior: Manipulates water flow rates through submerged infrastructure valves. Objects caught in the currents arrive at predictable destinations.
story_hooks: Salvage divers realize Undertow has been pushing pre-collapse artifacts toward the same collection point for years — building an underwater archive
